method: pair similarity = 0.5 * IDF-weighted token Dice + 0.5 * variable-masked sequence ratio; precision = agent->paper best match over all displayed equations; recall = one-to-one match of the paper's main equations (labelled, else numbered); math_score = (F1 - control F1) / (1 - control F1), control = same agent equations vs 20 random other papers. Lexical/structural similarity, not equivalence.
exact_correctness: not scored: the dataset has no ground-truth circuits or outputs
